bibliographic.title: Code of Ages
bibliographic.author: Edorg Games
bibliographic.description:
CODE OF AGES – THE TRUTH AWAKENS
"You found an artifact that should not exist. Now, it remembers you."

It is 02:47 AM. As an amateur historian, you are used to digging through the shadows of official records. But tonight, an anonymous tip leads you to an abandoned warehouse at the North Harbor – and what you discover among the rusting shipping containers tears the very fabric of reality.

The artifact hurls your consciousness through the aeons. You witness the raw dawn of the world, fight wars in long-forgotten civilizations, and return again and again to a present day where the facade of normality is crumbling.

The planets are aligning. The Arctic ice is melting at an unnatural pace. Something ancient is stirring in the depths – and you are the only one holding the key to survival.

⏳ Journey through 8 Epochs:
🌑 The Beginning – Before time began. The world belongs to "Others."
🔥 Prehistoric Era – The first war. A secret is sealed deep within the Earth's core.
🏛️ Antiquity – Pyramids and Gods. Discover who truly laid the foundations of the world.
⚔️ Middle Ages – The dark power lurking behind the thrones of Europe.
⚙️ Industrial Age – Progress follows a plan. But whose vision drives it?
📡 Present Day – The Awakening. The clock is ticking relentlessly.
🐉 Near Future – What slept beneath the ice is now hungry.
🌌 Far Future – The final consequence. Your choice defines the fate of all.
🎮 Key Features:
⚔️ Strategic Combat: Choose wisely between Attack, Block, Special Skills, or taking a tactical breath.
💀 Metamorphosis: Death is a core mechanic. Every rebirth changes you – but the fifth metamorphosis is final.
📜 Knowledge & Karma: What you learn and how you act opens new paths or closes them forever.
🌿 High Replayability: Discover 4 distinct endings. Will you become the guardian or the collateral damage of history?
🌐 Bilingual: Seamlessly playable in both German and English.
The truth never left. It was only waiting. Now, it is in your hands.
